study_status: Exploratory comparison on a previously evaluated test split

primary_comparison.limitation: Conditional on observed classes and independent audited images; unknown plant/farm dependence is not corrected.
primary_comparison.scope: Descriptive interval for the seed-17 model pair on the previously evaluated test split; not an interval for the three-seed mean or a fresh confirmatory test.

majority_class_baseline.selection: Most frequent training class; smallest label breaks ties

amendment.status: Descriptive analysis amendment recorded during follow-up training, before any new follow-up test evaluation
existing_metrics_retained: Per-run total and mean training time
Pooled total time, total epochs and time per epoch
additional_descriptive_statistics: Per-run median observed training epoch time
Per-configuration median, first and third quartiles, interquartile range, minimum and maximum across every observed training epoch from all three seeds
amendment.cost_figure_metric: Median observed training epoch time with interquartile range, pooled across all completed epochs in each model/arm
amendment.exclusions_or_corrections: None: no epoch is removed, replaced, corrected or assigned a cause
amendment.interpretation: Medians describe typical observed durations; raw means and totals retain long observations. Unequal completed epoch counts weight seeds differently in pooled summaries. These durations are not corrected or controlled hardware benchmarks.

timing_analysis.figure_metric: Median observed training epoch time, pooled across all completed epochs in the three seeds
timing_analysis.quantiles: NumPy linear interpolation; IQR = Q3 - Q1; every observed epoch retained
timing_analysis.interpretation: Descriptive measured durations, not corrected hardware benchmarks. Different completed epoch counts weight seeds differently in pooled epoch summaries; raw run totals, run means and pooled means remain reported. No cause is assigned to unusually long epochs.

interpretation_limits: Exploratory follow-up: the original DINOv2 test results were known before this study; the reused test split is not fresh confirmatory evidence.
Model sizes, pretraining data, pooling and native preprocessing differ; the comparison does not isolate model age or pretraining objective.
Fixed learning rates and adaptation depth were not separately optimised for each model.
Three training seeds describe limited optimisation variability, not independent datasets or external population uncertainty.
Unknown plant/farm dependence and pretraining overlap remain; no external dataset establishes geographic or field generalisation.
A recent competitive model family does not establish the newest or best model in October 2026, or state-of-the-art performance on Beans.
Clean training/validation diagnostics reuse development data; a small gap does not prove absence of overfitting.
